The meal is a plate of lo mein-style noodles, a bowl of fruit salad (strawberries, grapes, watermelon), and a cup of water.

Estimates for what was served:
- Noodles: about 250 g of cooked, oily noodles at roughly 1.6 kcal/g, so about 400 kcal. Of this, about 60 g is carbohydrate, 10 g protein and 14 g fat.
- Fruit salad: about 150 g at roughly 0.5 kcal/g, so about 75 kcal. Of this, about 18 g is carbohydrate, 1 g protein and 0.4 g fat.
- Total served: about 475 kcal.

I can't see how much will be left over from a before-eating photo, so I assumed about 10% is left, roughly 45 kcal. That leaves about 430 kcal eaten.

Scaling the macronutrients to 90% of the served totals gives about 70 g carbohydrate, 10 g protein and 13 g fat.
